dataset_name: Adobe Company-wise Coding Interview Preparation Bank
focus: Adobe-style coding preparation: arrays/strings, recursion, trees, backtracking, DP and problem-solving.
note: Publicly reported interview-preparation questions are not official or guaranteed interview questions. The first 100 are representative core problems; remaining entries are clearly marked practice variants. No code solutions are included.
